name: B10-0220/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Execution spree in Iran and the confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to cancel the death sentences of Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani, two activists it says were tortured and tried unfairly. It condemns Iran's record number of executions and asks Iran to stop using the death penalty and free political prisoners. It also asks European countries to support Iranian civil society, sanction those responsible for rights abuses, and offer visas to people who need to leave Iran. These are requests and opinions, not decisions that change any law.

- Iran is asked to cancel two death sentences and free political prisoners.
- European Union countries are urged to sanction abusers and help Iranians who flee.
- The Parliament asks the European Union to keep supporting United Nations human rights work in Iran.
